name: Seawise.io Client
description: Share your self-hosted apps with family and friends without port forwarding. Outbound-only tunnel, no open ports. Requires a free Seawise.io account.
longDescription:
Seawise.io Client connects your server to Seawise.io over an outbound-only tunnel, so you can share apps like Jellyfin, Immich, Home Assistant or Nextcloud without opening ports or setting up a VPN.

Add an app by its local address (for example http://192.168.1.10:8096), and Seawise.io gives it a secure link. Share it with family and friends, or group apps into portals.

Requires a free account at seawise.io. After install, open the Web UI within 5 minutes to set a password, then pair the client with your account.
